name: isabel_pixel_streaming_health_handshake
purpose: Gate the live Isabel session until browser, Pixel Streaming transport, Unreal runtime, character runtime, camera, and all four monitor surfaces prove healthy.

degraded_rules.voice_unavailable: Allow typed control and visual presence; do not fake speech.
degraded_rules.memory_unavailable: Continue session-local only; do not invent recalled preferences.
degraded_rules.project_data_unavailable: Keep office live and mark affected screens unavailable/stale.
degraded_rules.single_screen_feed_unavailable: Degrade only that screen; keep physical surface and other screens live.

acceptance: Browser cannot label the session LIVE until a fresh Unreal health snapshot satisfies the live gate.
A stale heartbeat automatically moves the browser to DEGRADED then OFFLINE without destroying continuity state.
A recovered data channel triggers a fresh health request before commands resume.
No external action is replayed as part of reconnect or health recovery.
Screen health is independent per monitor.
The browser always distinguishes renderer offline from Isabel reasoning/data services offline.
